chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to the men: 'Clip your nails', and to the women: 'Leave them, for it is an adornment for you'.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on clipping fingernails for men versus women?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Prophetic emphasis on *fitrah* (natural disposition) by prescribing nail clipping for men while encouraging women to preserve length for aesthetic adornment. It reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that grooming practices are not merely hygienic but also serve to distinguish gender roles and enhance beauty within Islamic etiquette.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny who said,
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said to the men: ‘Clip your nails’, and (said) to the women: ‘Leave them for it is an adornment for you’.
en.sarwar: 15. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
Men must clip their fingernails and women must keep them because it is more beautifying for them.’”
